instruction.text: Find the word, law, in the image.

feedback.end: Laws are created by the government and apply to everyone in a given society. They are like rules that everyone should follow. Things that are against the law are illegal.

instruction.text: Match the law with the reason for having it.

atoms.b: because it is unfair to take what belongs to others.
because it’s our duty to keep the planet clean.

atoms.a: Do not drive through a red light...
atoms.b: so you don’t cause an accident.

instruction.text: Who makes sure different laws are followed? Select the correct image.

feedback.finish: Police officers make sure people follow the law in public spaces. They also rush to your aid if you call them.

instruction.text: Listen and select what can happen if you break the law.

feedback.finish: Depending on the law broken, a person either has to pay a fine, do community service or spend time in prison. This is known as a penalty.

b.sound: You are invited to court and your matter is discussed in a public space.
You have a drink with the judge and privately talk about the offence.

instruction.text: Read the text and fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: If someone breaks the law by driving through a red light, they could ((++be_fined go_to_prison)) up to £1,000.
If this person breaks the law by breaking into ((++a_bank a_tin_of_biscuits)), he could be sent to prison for life.
Be a good citizen by following the ((++law rule))!
